purpose: Improve measured readiness across the eight unweighted official dimensions; no promised score.
authorization: Local improvements in a new preserved copy. No installations, credentials, live API calls, publication or deletion.
agent_acceptance: Actual forecast, evidence, solver and selection-simulation observations are consumed by bounded decision checkpoints.
Replies must echo the exact packet hash, cite supplied observation references and choose an allowed action/proposal.
Unknown actions, fabricated/stale references, changed financial permissions and invalid schemas fail closed.
At most six provider attempts persist across retries; clarification or stop never publishes or activates a plan.
Offline policy, mocked provider and manual native-model review are independently labelled; no live API evidence is claimed.

selection_protocol.report_seed: User-supplied seed; never consulted to choose/repair the portfolio
selection_protocol.matched_conditions: Same snapshots, authorized constraints, common random numbers, scenario count and demand assumptions within each comparison.
selection_protocol.acceptance: Zero hard-constraint violations and complete reporting including losses/ties; no AI superiority threshold or tuning on held-out results.

extraction_protocol.metrics: Exact non-null critical precision = correct emitted / emitted; coverage = correct emitted / ground-truth answerable fields. Null expected fields are counted separately; corrupt inputs and contradictions are separate strata.
extraction_protocol.acceptance: 100% critical precision on this finite holdout; target >=80% critical coverage per supported modality. Unsupported modalities remain explicitly gated. Human confirmation always required.
extraction_protocol.no_leakage: Production parser must not read fixtures, filenames, ground truth, seed or model-review answers. Final holdout generated/run after implementation is frozen; no tuning after results.

robustness_acceptance: Existing tests plus meaningful new decision/provenance regressions pass.
Cross-worker lease, restart, idempotency and atomic stock/budget behavior remain enforced.
Browser verifies onboarding, current evidence versions, saved versus draft scope, report seed/count and recovery.
Production crash durability is not inferred from test-only SQLite MEMORY journaling.
external_gates: No retailer pilot or causal ROI evidence
No production concurrency/load or deployment proof
Native Luna review is manual model-in-loop evidence only
